As Apple (AAPL) Shares Declined, Shareholder Marsico Capital Management Trimmed Stake by $10.47 Million; Omega Healthcare Invs (OHI) Shareholder Sterneck Capital Management Has Upped Its Position by $839,700 as Stock Declined
April 27, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Sterneck Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Omega Healthcare Invs Inc (OHI) by 46.24% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sterneck Capital Management Llc bought 31,100 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.90% with the market. The institutional investor held 98,364 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.71 million, up from 67,264 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sterneck Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Omega Healthcare Invs Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.35 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.87% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $25.8. About 1.86M shares traded. Omega Healthcare Investors, Inc. (NYSE:OHI) has declined 18.67% since April 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 30.22% the S&P500.
Marsico Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 13.66% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Marsico Capital Management Llc sold 61,929 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 391,591 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $66.27M, down from 453,520 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Marsico Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $823.61B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.16% or $1.9 during the last trading session, reaching $162.32. About 35.51M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Marsico Capital Management Llc, which manages about $17.14 billion and $2.50 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Activision Blizzard Inc (NASDAQ:ATVI) by 295,593 shares to 1.01M shares, valued at $63.80 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Alkermes Plc (NASDAQ:ALKS) by 8,869 shares in the quarter, for a total of 48,723 shares, and has risen its stake in Take (NASDAQ:TTWO).
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1 after the close. They expect $2.71 earnings per share, up 29.05% or $0.61 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75 billion for 14.97 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth.
